newsitem.title: UK: Dixons appoints three managers to board.
newsitem.headline: Dixons appoints three managers to board.

text.p: British electronics and computer retailer Dixons Group Plc said on Monday it had promoted three senior managers to its board.

David Gilbert, managing director of the Currys domestic electrical retailing business, David Hamid, managing director of Dixons commercial services, and Ian Livingston, finance and systems director, will all join the board effective May 4, Dixons said in a statement.
The appointments reflect the growth of the business and the focus on UK retail activities, it said.
